title: Antique Brass Freestanding Coat Rack With Eight Pivoting Pegs, 60-Inch Solid Brass, Assorted Free Standing Accessories, Allied Brass
description:
Keep a bathroom entry or dressing area neat by giving towels, robes, coats, and hats a dedicated place to land in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This freestanding coat rack (also called a coat stand or floor coat rack) uses eight pivoting pegs to separate items so they hang neatly and stay easy to reach.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stable placement: weighted base is designed to prevent tipping
- Floor-friendly: felt pad helps prevent scratching on tile, wood, or other surfaces
- Durable metal build: solid brass construction (brass construction)

Specs & Installation:

- Dimensions: 10 in (L) x 60 in (H) x 10 in (W)
- Weight capacity: 18 lb
- Mounting: freestanding (not wall-mounted / not wall hanging)
- Material: brass
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Included items: freestanding coat rack
- Collection: Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection
